subject: sum of empirical Bayes estimates of N in Nmix model

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: sum of empirical Bayes estimates of N in Nmix model
parts:
Dear all,

I am fitting an Nmix model using pcount() and want to obtain an estimate of the total abundance across all sites. That is, I want to sum up the empirical Bayes estimates of the random effects N, which I get by typing ranef(fm). However, doing sum(ranef(fm)) doesn't work.

Thanks for help, and apologies if this has been answered before !

Kind regards -- Marc

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] sum of empirical Bayes estimates of N in Nmix model
parts:
Hi Marc,

ranef() compute the posteriors, and bup() returns the mean or mode of the posteriors. See ?ranef for some examples and more details.

Richard
